scope: Build 1 Paperclip execution and CommsOps repair
root_causes: Skipper route-final records can carry an empty final transport chunk; those route-final records are transport evidence only and must not be read as substantive model output.
Paperclip server PATH resolved codex to /usr/bin/codex v0.34.0, while the working CLI is /home/x/.local/bin/codex v0.140.0.
Paperclip recorded parsed Codex JSON error events as heartbeat success when the Codex process returned exit code 0.
Codex shell environment filtering prevented Paperclip run context such as PAPERCLIP_API_KEY and PAPERCLIP_RUN_ID from reaching shell commands inside Codex.
Manual Paperclip starts could miss the agent JWT context; systemd startup with /etc/paperclip/systemd/config.json and runtime.env is the stable control-plane path.
